components.name: Double-ruled Control
components.description: Square double-ruled button; hatches on hover/active. Used for the install copy action, Read the claims and the random generators.
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.9em; min-height:52px; padding:0 1.4rem; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper, #fdfdfb); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper, #fdfdfb), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ink, #111111); color:var(--ink, #111111); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:0.875rem; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-control:hover, .ds-control:active { background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(17 17 17 / 0.22) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--carmine, #b31a1a); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-mono { font-family:var(--font-type, "Courier Prime", "Courier New", monospace); font-size:1rem; letter-spacing:0.02em; text-transform:none; } .ds-control-hint { padding-left:0.9em; border-left:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); }

components.name: Small Control
components.description: 44px double-ruled copy button for install rows; shows carmine Copied for 2s.
components.css: .ds-control-small { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 0.9rem; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper, #fdfdfb); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper, #fdfdfb), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ink, #111111); color:var(--ink, #111111); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:0.75rem; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-control-small:hover { background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(17 17 17 / 0.22) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); } .ds-control-small:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--carmine, #b31a1a); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-copied { color:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); }

components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:0.75rem; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-field { width:100%; min-height:64px; padding:0 1rem; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper, #fdfdfb); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper, #fdfdfb), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ink, #111111); color:var(--ink, #111111); caret-color:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); font-family:var(--font-type, "Courier Prime", "Courier New", monospace); font-size:1.75rem; letter-spacing:0.08em; appearance:none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--ink-soft, #555555); opacity:1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--carmine, #b31a1a); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Title-block Nav
components.description: Figure navigation in the title block; current figure underlined in carmine.
components.html: Fig. 1Fig. 2Fig. 3Claims
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:0.5rem; padding:0 1.5rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); background:var(--paper, #fdfdfb); } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 0.6rem; color:var(--ink, #111111); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:0.875rem; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:0.22em; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-color:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); text-decoration-thickness:2px; text-underline-offset:0.5em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--carmine, #b31a1a); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Reference Numerals Table
components.description: Italic numeral, mono part, right-aligned mono reading; flagged row in carmine.
components.css: .ds-ref { width:100%; max-width:290px; border-collapse:collapse; font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:0.9375rem; color:var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-ref th, .ds-ref td { padding:0.45rem 0; text-align:left; font-weight:400; } .ds-ref thead th { border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); font-size:0.75rem; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft, #555555); } .ds-ref td:first-child { width:2.6em; font-style:italic; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-ref tbody th { font-family:var(--font-type, "Courier Prime", "Courier New", monospace); font-size:0.875rem; } .ds-ref td:last-child { font-family:var(--font-type, "Courier Prime", "Courier New", monospace); text-align:right; } .ds-ref tbody tr + tr { border-top:1px solid var(--rule, #b7b7b7); } .ds-ref tr.is-flagged, .ds-ref tr.is-flagged th { color:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); }

components.name: Examiner's Stamp
components.description: Rotated circular stamp; carmine when an ID is valid, dashed grey PENDING otherwise.
components.css: .ds-stamp { width:136px; aspect-ratio:1; transform:rotate(-11deg); animation:ds-land 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } .ds-stamp svg { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:visible; } .ds-rim { fill:none; stroke:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); stroke-width:2; } .ds-thin { stroke-width:1; } .ds-ring { fill:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:0.2em; } .ds-main { fill:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:20px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.08em; } .ds-sub { fill:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); font-family:var(--font-type, "Courier Prime", "Courier New", monospace); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:0.06em; } @keyframes ds-land { from { opacity:0; transform:rotate(-4deg) scale(1.45); } to { opacity:1; transform:rotate(-11deg) scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stamp { animation:none; } }

components.name: Control Letter Cells
components.description: Hairline-ruled letter cells; the examined remainder gets carmine hatch and outline.
components.css: .ds-letters { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 4rem); margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); color:var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-letters li { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; min-height:7.5rem; padding:0.6rem 0.5rem; transition:background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-letters li + li { border-left:1px solid var(--rule, #b7b7b7); } .ds-letters i { font-size:0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-letters span { font-size:2.5rem; line-height:1; } .ds-letters li.is-on { background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(179 26 26 / 0.35) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); color:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--carmine, #b31a1a); }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-bench { display:grid; gap:1rem; width:100%; max-width:480px; } .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem; padding-bottom:1rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-bar { display:block; height:18px; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(17 17 17 / 0.22) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); } .ds-time { font-family:var(--font-type, "Courier Prime", "Courier New", monospace); color:var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-row.is-subject .ds-bar { border-color:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(179 26 26 / 0.35) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); } .ds-row.is-subject .ds-time { color:var(--carmine, #b31a1a); }

components.description: Figure title and engraved section title over a ruled line with a centre crosshair.

components.css: .ds-head { display:grid; gap:1.5rem; color:var(--ink, #111111); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); } .ds-head h2 { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:baseline; gap:0.4em 1.25em; margin:0; font-weight:400; } .ds-fig { font-size:2.5rem; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-title { font-size:clamp(1.875rem, 3vw, 2.75rem); line-height:1.15; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-cross { position:relative; height:15px; } .ds-cross::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:7px; border-top:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-cross::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:50%; top:0; width:13px; height:13px; margin-left:-7px; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(var(--ink, #111111), var(--ink, #111111)) center / 1px 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--ink, #111111), var(--ink, #111111)) center / 100% 1px no-repeat, var(--paper, #fdfdfb); }

components.css: .ds-install { display:grid; gap:1rem; max-width:320px; padding:1.5rem; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper, #fdfdfb), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ink, #111111); background:var(--paper, #fdfdfb); color:var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-install h3 { margin:0; font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-irow { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; padding-bottom:0.5rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule, #b7b7b7); } .ds-irow code { font-family:var(--font-type, "Courier Prime", "Courier New", monospace); font-size:0.92em; } .ds-irow button { min-height:44px; padding:0 0.9rem; border:1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper, #fdfdfb); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper, #fdfdfb), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ink, #111111); font-family:var(--font-serif, "Old Standard TT", "Times New Roman", serif); font-size:0.75rem; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-irow button:hover { background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(17 17 17 / 0.22) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); } .ds-irow button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--carmine, #b31a1a); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a single utility-patent sheet on white bond: a double-ruled border with circular registration marks at its four corners, a title block across the top and bottom, and every section filed as a numbered figure (Fig. 1, Fig. 2, Fig. 3) or as the claims. India-ink line does all the work. Tone comes from 45° section hatching, never from tinted panels. One colour, carmine, marks whatever is under examination: the control letter, a flagged reading, the subject row of a benchmark, the examiner's stamp once an ID passes.

Type is split by register, as on a real filing. Engraved open-serif capitals with wide tracking (Old Standard TT) set titles, figure labels and reference numerals; a typewriter mono (Courier Prime) carries anything that is data or specification: IDs, function names, code, measurements. The density is that of a drafting sheet: hairline cells, small tracked labels, generous margins inside each cell, no decoration that is not also a drawing convention (leaders, dimension lines, centre axes, crosshair dividers).

The world rejects the dark dev-tool hero with a code block and feature cards. Everything is flat paper and ink; depth is drawn, not lit.
keyCharacteristics: White bond paper, india-ink line, carmine for the thing under examination.
45° hatching as the only tonal fill.
Engraved tracked serif capitals for titles; typewriter mono for data.
Square, double-ruled controls and fields; circles only for registration marks, crosshairs, leader dots and the stamp.
Exploded-view figures with curved leader lines to italic reference numerals.
Every section is a cell of the sheet, separated by 1px ink rules.

rules.name: The Examination Rule
rules.body: Carmine marks the one thing being examined in a view, plus focus, hover, current and copied states. If two unrelated things on one figure are carmine, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Bond-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are paper; there are no tinted panels or grey cards. Paper may be used as a solid fill only to knock lines out behind a mark (registration marks, crosshair, leader dots, control faces).

rules.name: The Register Rule
rules.body: Prose and titles are serif; anything a developer would type or read back from the library (IDs, function calls, commands, times) is Courier Prime.

rules.name: The Engraved Caps Rule
rules.body: Every title-level line is uppercase Old Standard TT at weight 400 with tracking between 0.08em and 0.24em. Weight never carries hierarchy at title level; size and tracking do.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: New content is filed as a cell or figure of the sheet, bounded by 1px ink rules, never floated as a card on the paper.

rules.name: The Drawn Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is drawn, never lit: hatching, axes and double rules, not blur or offset shadows.

dos: **Do** file new content as a ruled cell or a numbered figure of the sheet, with a figure title, crosshair rule and lede.
**Do** use hatching (`--hatch-fill`, `--hatch-fill-carmine`, 45°, 1px stroke every 7px) for any tonal fill, including active control states.
**Do** keep carmine for the item under examination and for focus, hover, current and copied states.
**Do** set IDs, function names, commands and measurements in Courier Prime, and titles in tracked uppercase Old Standard TT at 400.
**Do** use square double-ruled controls (1px border plus the inset paper/ink rule) with 44px minimum targets.
**Do** connect annotations to their subject with leader lines and italic reference numerals.
donts: **Don't** introduce tinted panels, gradients or grey cards; the sheet is paper and ink.
**Don't** add drop shadows or blur for elevation; the only shadows are inset rules.
**Don't** round control, field or cell corners; circles belong only to drafting marks and the stamp.
**Don't** use carmine decoratively or on more than the examined item in a figure.
**Don't** set titles in bold; hierarchy at title level comes from size and tracking.
